# Miauterm 0.1.7-coral

This release follows 0.1.6 with a small set of fixes. It is still experimental.

## Fixes

- Resetting Debian no longer leaves a background `apt-get` process holding the package manager lock. Automatic installation of optional network packages was removed. `resolv.conf` is still written, and optional packages can be installed with `apt` inside Debian.
- Primary buttons in confirmation dialogs use white text on a darker orange background, so the action is readable.
- Extra-key buttons use a 40 dp size, closer to Termux, instead of the larger size from earlier builds.
- Startup no longer closes the app when the session list is empty during notification permission changes.
- First-run extraction is no longer cancelled when the activity is recreated. A completed extraction is handed to the new activity.
- The bootstrap dialog starts at 0% and uses a determinate progress bar.

## Known issues

This release does not fix every reported problem. Some issues remain open:

- The bootstrap progress bar may still appear empty or stall on some devices during first-run extraction. Debian still installs and runs in the reported cases.
- Some dialog and tab touch targets remain below 48 dp.
- The app keeps `targetSdk 28`, which leaves some notification and storage permission code ineffective on newer Android versions.
- A full audit found additional bugs and quality issues that are not addressed in this release.

Use this build for testing, not as a guaranteed bug-free release. Report problems with a diagnostic log from Settings.
